sloka: मोघमस्त्रं न शक्यं तु कर्तुमित्येव राघव ।भवांस्तस्याक्षि काकस्य हिनस्ति स्म स दक्षिणम् ।। ५.६७.१७ ।।।।
transliteration: moghamastraṁ na śakyaṁ tu kartumityeva rāghava ।bhavāṁstasyākṣi kākasya hinasti sma sa dakṣiṇam ।। 5.67.17 ।।।।

translations.english: The crow, once released, regained its own abode. "Thus, though you are the best among knowers of missiles, of great being and of good character too —
